title: Sirtuins, Autophagy, and Brain Longevity | Springer Nature Link
abstract:
## Abstract

The aging brain represents one of the most complex challenges in modern medicine, involving intricate interactions between cellular senescence, metabolic dysregulation, and impaired repair mechanisms. Emerging research highlights sirtuins and autophagy as central regulators of brain longevity, operating through interconnected pathways that mitigate age-related cognitive decline. This chapter explores their roles in maintaining neuronal health and combating neurodegenerative processes.
